title: A query whose length disagrees with its rows panics in `ProfileBuilder`
body:
`Profile::from_p7hmm` sizes the builder from the `LENG` line through `ProfileBuilder::length`. It then writes one row per model position with `ProfileBuilder::mat_emission(pos, ..)` and `ProfileBuilder::transition(pos, ..)`, which index those vectors with no bounds check. `ProfileBuilder::build` indexes `occupancy[1]` whatever the length, so a length-0 profile panics there. A FASTA query reaches the same builder through `Profile::from_blosum_62_and_seq`.

The input survey on nail-d551f7 ran each of these against the release binary:

| Input | What the user sees |
|---|---|
| p7hmm with `LENG 5` and more rows than that | `index out of bounds: the len is 6 but the index is 6` |
| p7hmm with `LENG 0` | the same panic |
| p7hmm with no `LENG` line | `index out of bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 0` |
| FASTA query record with an empty sequence | `index out of bounds: the len is 1 but the index is 1` |

## Proposal

`Profile::from_p7hmm` returns an error naming the model when `LENG` is missing or 0, when a row's position is past `LENG`, or when the model has fewer rows than `LENG`. A FASTA query record with an empty sequence fails with an error naming the record.

## Open

- whether an empty FASTA query record is an error or is skipped with a warning; nobody has checked what HMMER does
close_reason: from_p7hmm checks LENG at the HMM line and each row against it; from_blosum_62_and_seq rejects an empty sequence. An empty fasta query is an error, not a skip, see note. Committed on dev.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/69ba1bc3
notes.text: On the open question: `phmmer` 3.4 given a fasta with an empty first record and one real one reports one query model and says nothing about the empty record. nail reports an error instead. Skipping would shift the position of every later query, which the seeds and the output use to find records, so skipping needs the slot kept and is its own issue if wanted.
